def f(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r if c)
    # shapes: rectangles of a repeated color, 5 wide x5 tall-ish? find all maximal same-color rectangular blocks
    seen=set(); res=[]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            c=g[i][j]
            if c==0 or (c,i,j) in seen: continue
            # extend to rectangle: rows where this block continues consecutively... find max rect anchored here
            h=w=1
            while i+h<H and g[i+h][j]==c and g[i][j+w]==c and all(g[i+hh][j+jw]==c for hh in range(h, i+h+1) for jw in range(j+w)):
                h+=1; w+=1
            while i>=0 and j+w<W and g[i-h][j]==c and g[i][j+w]==c and all(g[i-h-xx][j]==c and g[i][j+w-yy]==c for xx in range(1,h) for yy in range(1,w)):
                pass
            seen.add((c,i,j))
            res.append((h,w,c,i,j))
    best=max(res,key=lambda t:t[2])  # pick largest area? demo: 4x3? check sizes
    return [[best[2]]*best[0]][[best[2]]*best[1]]
print(f(G['Demo pair 1 input']), G['Demo pair 1 output'])
